title: Premier Money Market Levels and the Share of a Personal Checking Claimed Total That Is Credited
content:
**Clause.** The share of the claimed total credited to a Personal Checking account moves with the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts and with the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

1. Where the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00 **and** the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months, the whole of the claimed total is credited, that is a share of 1.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner holds any premier money market balance at all **or** has made at least 3 card payments in the last twelve months, three quarters of it is credited, that is a share of 0.75.
3. Where neither case applies, neither of those shares is taken.

**Worked shares on hypothetical inputs.** On a claimed total of 320.00:

| Owner's position | Claimed total taken at the credited share |
|---|---|
| Premier money market balance of 9000.00, 8 card payments in the last twelve months | 320.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 9000.00, 2 card payments | 240.00, the any-balance limb of the second case being met |
| Premier money market balance of 40.00, 1 card payment | 240.00 |
| No premier money market balance, 5 card payments | 240.00 |
| No premier money market balance, 1 card payment | Neither share is taken |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone, and any premier money market balance above zero satisfies its first limb. Equality satisfies each threshold, so a balance of exactly 5000.00 with exactly 6 card payments reaches the first case.
